CREATECONTRACT.GASPRICE: Qiimaha Gaaska (MRX halkii cutub ee gaaska)
CREATECONTRACT.ESTIMATEDMAXCOST: Qiimaha ugu badan ee la qiyaasay
CREATECONTRACT.INCOMPLETEFORM: Fadlan dooro cinwaan soo diraha, geli bytecode sax ah, oo deji xadka/qiimaha gaaska ee saxda ah
CREATECONTRACT.HIGHGASPRICEINFO: Qiimaha gaaska ee aad dejisay waa mid aan caadi ahayn oo sarreeya. Hawlgalkan wuxuu ku kici karaa ilaa:
CREATECONTRACT.DEPLOYED: Soo gudbinta qandaraaska ayaa la gudbiyay

SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Waxaad ku saxiixi kartaa fariimo cinwaanadaada si aad u caddeyso inaad leedahay. Ka digtoonow inaadan saxiixin wax aan caddayn, maadaama weerarrada phishing-ku ay isku dayi karaan inay kugu khiyaaneeyaan inaad aqoonsigaaga u saxiixdo. Kaliya saxiix hadallo faahfaahsan oo aad ogolaatay.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Geli cinwaanka saxiixa, fariinta (hubi inaad si sax ah u koobiyeyso jebinta xariiqyada, meelaha bannaan, tabs-ka, iwm.) iyo saxiixa hoose si aad u xaqiijiso fariinta. Ka digtoonow inaadan wax badan ka akhriyin saxiixa marka loo eego waxa ku jira fariinta la saxiixay, si aad uga fogaato inaad ku khiyaanto weerar nin-dhexe ah.

DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO: Kusoo dhawoow qalabka Metrix Core RPC. Ku qor caawimo si aad u hesho dulmar guud oo ku saabsan amarrada la heli karo.
DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: DIGNIIN: Khiyaamo-yaqaannada ayaa firfircoonaa, iyagoo dadka isticmaala u sheegaya inay amarrada halkan ku qoraan, iyagoo xadaya waxa ku jira boorsadooda. Ha isticmaalin qalabkan adigoon si buuxda u fahmin ujeeddada amarka.

REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: Amarradan dayactirka lama socodsiin karo marka Metrix Core si dibadda ah loo maamulo.
REPAIR.INFO: Badhamada hoose waxay dib u bilaabi doonaan Metrix Core iyagoo adeegsanaya ikhtiyaarrada khadka taliska si loo hagaajiyo boorsada, loo hagaajiyo arrimaha faylasha blockchain ee musuqmaasuqa ah ama macaamil ganacsi oo maqan/gaboobay.
REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Isku day inaad furayaasha gaarka ah ka soo ceshato boorso musuqmaasuq ah.dat.
REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Dib u sawir blockchain-ka si aad u ogaato macaamilka jeebka ee maqan.
REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Soo cesho macaamil ganacsiyeedyada blockchain (hayso xogta meta-data, tusaale ahaan milkiilaha akoonka)
REPAIR.RECOVER2INFO: -zapwallettxes=2: Soo cesho macaamil ganacsiyeedyada blockchain (soo daa xogta meta-data)
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: U cusbooneysii boorsada jeebka qaabkii ugu dambeeyay marka la bilaabayo. (Fiiro gaar ah: tani MAAHA cusbooneysiinta boorsada lafteeda!)
REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Dib u dhis tusmada blockchain laga bilaabo faylasha blk000 ee hadda jira.
REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Soo dejinta faylasha Metrix blockchain ee metrixcoin.com oo dib u rakib rakibaaddaada. Iyada oo ku xidhan xidhiidhka shabakadaada tani waxay qaadan kartaa 10 daqiiqo ilaa dhowr saacadood.
REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Tirtir faylashaada blockchain ee deegaankaaga oo dib uga soo celi xannibaadda hiddaha.
REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Dib u bilow Metrix Core haddii uu hore u shaqeynayay ama bilow Metrix Core haddii uusan shaqaynayn.
REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Tirtir Metrix Core-kaaga maxalliga ah oo dib uga soo deji server-yada Metrix.

EXPLORER.TOKENDISCOVERYINFO: Adeegga akhriska oo keliya ayaa loo isticmaalay in lagu ogaado calaamadaha MRC20/MRC721 ee cinwaanka boorsada uu la falgalay. Hadhaaga iyo lahaanshaha had iyo jeer waa la hubiyaa marka loo eego jinnigaaga ka hor inta aan la tusin ama la isticmaalin - tan waxaa loo isticmaalaa oo keliya in lagu helo calaamadaha si loo hubiyo.

DEVELOPER.DEVMODEINFO: Dami caadi ahaan waxaana loogu talagalay horumariyayaasha oo keliya. Awoodsiinta tan waxay muujineysaa ikhtiyaarro lagu beddeli karo xiriirka RPC - isticmaalayaasha caadiga ah waa inay ka tagaan tan.
DEVELOPER.WARNING: Dejintan waxaa loogu talagalay ujeeddooyin horumarineed oo keliya. Beddelkooda waxay ka hortagi kartaa in boorsada jeebka ay ku xirto jinni gabi ahaanba - isticmaal tan oo keliya haddii aad taqaanid waxaad samaynayso.
DEVELOPER.RPCHOSTINFO: Sida caadiga ah, Altitude waxay ku xiran tahay daemon-ka ay iskeed u maamusho, mashiinkan (127.0.0.1). Ka-dhaafidda kuwan waxay u oggolaanaysaa inay ku xidho daemon kale - tusaale ahaan tusaale regtest fog, iyada oo aan loo baahnayn in mid lagu socodsiiyo gudaha. Haddii xiriirku guuleysto, Altitude ma soo dejisan doonto ama ma bilaabi doonto daemon-keeda maxalliga ah. rpcallowip-ka daemon ee bartilmaameedka ah waa inuu oggolaadaa xiriirkan, rpcuser/rpcpassword-ka hoose waa inuu la mid noqdaa habayntiisa. Isla markiiba ayuu dhaqan galayaa, dib-u-bilaabis looma baahna.

GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Guddoomiyeyaasha gobollada ayaa mas'uul ka ah codbixinta miisaaniyadaha bilaha ah iyo isbeddellada blockchain. Waxaad noqon kartaa Guddoomiye adigoo xiraya dammaanadda saxda ah ee qandaraaska Maamulka.
GOVERNANCE.SELECTAGOVERNOR: Dooro cinwaan guddoomiye oo u qalma
GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad iska diiwaangeliso Guddoomiye ahaan. Tani waxay qandaraaska maamulka u diri doontaa macaamil ganacsi oo leh dammaanadda loo baahan yahay. Waad ka bixi kartaa diiwaangelinta wakhti kasta.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Guddoomiyeyaasha gobollada ayaa mas'uul ka ah codbixinta miisaaniyadaha bilaha ah iyo isbeddellada blockchain.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: Si aad u sii ahaato Guddoomiye Gobol, waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad ka qaybgasho ugu yaraan 1 cod 30kii maalmoodba mar.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: Haddii aysan jirin wax aad codaynayso markaa waxaad gacanta ku sii wadi kartaa diiwaangelintaada adigoo diraya ping firfircoon.
GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAIL: Xaaladdaada diiwaangelinta Guddoomiyaha Gobolka ayaa muuqan doonta marka blockchain-kaagu si buuxda isula jaanqaado.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: Blockchain-ka Metrix wuxuu marayaa guuritaan DGP ah. Waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad ka baxdo qandaraaskii hore ee DGP oo aad dib isu diiwaangeliso kan cusub. Haddii aad leedahay Governor hore markaa waxaad arki doontaa oo keliya badhanka ka-bixista diiwaanka boggan.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: Diiwaangelinta cusub ee DGP waxay suurtogal noqon doontaa marka ay dhacdo kicinta onchain. Discord-keennu wuxuu ka koobnaan doonaa macluumaadka ugu dambeeyay ee arrintan ku saabsan.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1TITLE: Noocii hore ee ka bixitaanka DGP
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: Badhanka hoose wuxuu ka furi doonaa diiwaankaagii hore ee Guddoomiye wuxuuna soo celin doonaa damaanadaada.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Marka diiwaangelintaada la dhammeeyo, ikhtiyaarkan ayaa meesha ka bixi doona.

LIST.TITLE: Calaamado
LIST.EMPTYDETAIL: Altitude si toos ah ayuu u hubiyaa sahamiyaha baloogga calaamadaha MRC20 iyo MRC721 ee loo diray cinwaanadaada, ka dibna wuxuu hubiyaa wax walba oo toos ah oo ka soo horjeeda node-kaaga. Waxa kale oo aad ku dari kartaa calaamad gacanta haddii aad taqaan cinwaanka qandaraaska.
LIST.EMPTYDETAILCHECKINGDISABLED: Hubinta calaamadaha otomaatiga ah waa la damiyay, sidaa darteed cinwaanadaada laguma hubinayo calaamadaha. Dib u shid kor, ama ku dar calaamad gacanta haddii aad taqaan cinwaanka qandaraaska.
LIST.NONENUMERABLETOOLTIP: Ururintani ma taageerto liiska shay gaar ah - taas oo muujinaysa inta aad haysato.
LIST.CHECKINGENABLEDTOOLTIP: Hubinta calaamaduhu way shidan tahay - Heerka sare wuxuu si joogto ah u hubiyaa cinwaanadaada calaamadaha wuxuuna cusboonaysiiyaa dheelitirka. Guji si aad u damiso.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDTOOLTIP: Hubinta calaamadda waa dansan tahay - dhagsii si aad dib u shido.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDNOTICE: Hubinta calaamadaha tooska ah waa la damiyay. Cinwaanadaada lama baarayo si loo helo calaamadaha, hadhaagana lama cusbooneysiin doono. Wali waad ku dari kartaa calaamad gacanta.
